description: logH in its TTL time mode, which has no Hamiltonian of (r, p) alone: its analytic rates against central finite differences of the physical K and U under its two denominators (dr/ds = (∂K/∂p)/W, dp/ds = (∂U/∂r)/Ω), dW/ds against Ω differenced along the velocities and dt/ds against 1/W, W drawn independently of the state, over 64 random states, within REQ-VAL-171's tolerance at its step (REQ-VAL-170).
